title: The Consecrated Manifold
logline: An eccentric shipyard preacher anoints sublight thruster bells with sacred holy tallow, which a cynical mechanic discovers is just rendered kitchen cooking grease.

roles.description: Administers an orbital chapel-dock; fervently preaches that thrust chamber harmonic hums reflect the moral purity of the pilot.
An exhausted drive specialist buried in dockage fees who despises liturgical maintenance rituals.
A massive forged drive manifold adorned with copper litany ribbons and drenched in sacred tallow.
A converted fuel bay filled with incense vapor, altar racks, and brass oil basins.

public_situation: Pilots in {system} queue at an orbital monastery dock where engines are anointed with holy tallow to cure high-frequency vibration.
private_truth: The chapel replaces expensive synthetic fluorocarbon lubricant with cheap rendered food fat, pocketing the surplus to fund shrine expansions.

beats.public_change: The monastery announces an urgent call for consecrated supplies before a planetary pilgrimage fleet docks for engine blessings.

missions.reason: He needs specialized bulk cooking grease purchased from hydroponic stations and delivered quietly to the sanctuary storage tanks.
missions.private_fact: He genuinely believes animal fat infused with station prayer achieves equal heat dissipation to synthetic fluorocarbon oil.

beats.public_change: Several freshly anointed freighters suffer drive stall and foul-smelling exhaust fumes during orbital maneuvering burns.

missions.reason: She wants an independent spectral scan of the burnt manifold deposits to prove the sacred oil is caramelizing into solid carbon tar.
missions.private_fact: She is secretly skimming the chapel's discarded fluorocarbon drums and reselling them to illicit street racers.

player_choice.prompt: The test reveals the holy anointing oil is literally rendered fryer tallow, which is gumming up thrust injectors across the sector.

options.label: Hand the chemical proof to the technician to halt the blessings before the fleet arrives
Sell the test results to the chapel preacher in exchange for private absolution and free fuel credits
Sell industrial solvent to the preacher as a secret divine purifying water

beats.public_change: Dock mechanics refuse to hook up fuel lines to anointed ships, causing massive traffic congestion outside the monastery bay.

missions.reason: She needs certified industrial detergent retrieved from a hazmat locker to flush the fouled manifold before the pilot's reactor overheats.
missions.private_fact: She intends to display the greasy sludge container in the station common room to publicly mock liturgical mechanics.

resolutions.reached_by: The technician proves the oil is tallow and flushes the manifold, exposing the chapel's fraudulent maintenance rites.
resolutions.summary: {role:chapel_preacher} is exposed for using cooking fat on thrusters. The monastery loses its certification, and {role:drive_technician} opens an honest repair stall.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot showed that a shipyard chapel's miracle engine oil was just burnt fryer grease.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot blackmails the preacher for fuel credits, keeping the cooking grease substitution secret.
resolutions.summary: The chapel pays off quiet pilots to keep complaints muffled. Thrusters across {system} smell faintly of fried onions, but the monastery remains open for business.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot supplies synthetic detergent disguised as holy baptismal water, quietly fixing the problem without breaking faith.
resolutions.summary: Industrial detergent cleans the fouled thrusters under the guise of an holy ritual. The engines run clear, and {role:chapel_preacher} declares a miraculous cure.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot clears the tallow or ignores the situation completely.
resolutions.summary: The monastery continues anointing engines with frying oil. Burnt carbon tars up local trade shuttles, driving repair costs up while the preacher blesses the smoke.

loose_threads.detail: The holy anointing oil casks have commercial bakery wholesale serial numbers poorly painted over with ecclesiastical stencils.
A station agricultural ledger records bulk tallow shipments billed directly to a mysterious offshore debt escrow.

radio_hooks: Orbital monastery reports thirty percent drop in sublight engine vibrations following incense rites.
Dockside pilots complain of caramel odor and clogged injector filters after routine maintenance.
Station health officials open inquiry into missing agricultural fryer grease reserves.

voice_direction.chapel_preacher: Slow, rhythmic, and chanting. Speaks of fuel injectors and magnetic seals as sacred vessels, effortlessly ignoring worldly complaints.
voice_direction.drive_technician: Sharp, sarcastic, and clipped. Rattles off exact part specifications and refuses to validate any metaphysical explanations for mechanical failures.
